name: Hotel Sun Valley
beschreibung: The Hotel Sun Valley is situated in a quiet location in the Zillertal and offers a view of the surrounding mountain scenery. The design of the hotel combines elements of traditional Tiroler style with contemporary comfort. The rooms are equipped with a balcony, satellite television, and a private bathroom. The wellness area includes a sauna, a steam bath, and a relaxation room. The half-board offering includes a breakfast buffet and an evening meal with regional and international dishes. In winter, the nearby ski bus provides a connection to the ski areas. In summer, hikers and mountain bikers start directly from the hotel into the surrounding mountain scenery. The hotel is suitable for couples and families who value peace and relaxation.
